name: Eyebrow

props.description: With or without the leading rule.
props.name: variant

tagline: The small uppercase kicker above an editorial heading (gh#1435), led by a short ornament rule (`variant="ruled"`, default) or bare (`"plain"`). Face, size, tracking, colour and rule: `--editorial-eyebrow-*`, `--editorial-kicker-*`, `--editorial-ornament-color`.
usage: DO use it in the eyebrow slot of EditorialHero / EditorialSectionHead / EditorialBanner.
